items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: Albemarle appears well-positioned as EV demand grows; projects 10-20% CAGR lithium demand 2025-2030. ALB stock carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market driven by EV and stationary storage demand, supply lagging. Maintained 2026 outlook, expecting high end of scenario ranges; $100M run-rate savings YTD.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in six months; lithium price pullback on softer China EV demand, elevated inventories and mine restarts weighed on the stock.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike; must be ratified by member vote.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in 1H26 yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May; US Commerce imposed one-year block on black mass exports.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from energy storage pushes prices higher. Albemarle (ALB) noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May, significantly outstripping supply.
